Build an MPX with a Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized pistol grip, Annihilator flash hider, and a Steiner LAS/TAC 2 flashlight. It needs a sighting range above 300, ergonomics at or above 47, a weight below 4 kg, and combined recoil below 225. Don't tell anyone what this is for. Rumors spread quickly in Tarkov, and Reshala definitely won't be happy if word gets out.}} ==Requirements== * This quest is only obtainable by [[USEC]] PMCs. ==Objectives== * Modify a [[MPX|SIG MPX]] to comply with the given specifications ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Tech manual]] * Unlocks purchase of [[Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle]] (variant SOPMOD I) at [[Mechanic]] LL3 * Unlocks purchase of [[Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle]] (variant SAI) at [[Ref]] LL3 {{quote|Finished? Bring it here, I'll pass it on to the client as soon as possible.}} ==Guide== [[MPX]] specifications: * 60 Durability * 300 or greater sighting range * 47 or more ergonomics * 4 kg or less in weight * 225 or less recoil * [[AR-15 Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized pistol grip]] * [[Yankee Hill Annihilator multi-caliber flash hider]] * [[Steiner LAS/TAC 2 tactical flashlight]] ==Build== '''This is one example of many possible configurations.''' ====Notes:==== * This build is based on a standard [[MPX]] from [[Peacekeeper]] LL2. * The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
